message: 忘却の蕎麦ブラン

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, listen!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, yeah」
Looking at Nanaka's lips makes me remember our kiss, so I look away slightly.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Exams... are finally over, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, they are」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For a while there I wondered how things would turn out, and... nothing turned out well at all」

name: Synn
message: 「That's no good then」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What?」

name: Synn
message: 「You could've just gone to karaoke with Eddie, Sacchin, and the others」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I said. I promised I'd help out at the shop today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though you were just saying, 'Alright, time to have some fun!'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I ended up remembering」

name: Synn
message: 「More like, don't forget in the first place」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What about you, Synn? You could've gone along with them」

name: Synn
message: 「It's better when everyone's together」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... I guess so」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone else thought the same thing, which is why we decided to reschedule for another day」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though Azel probably won't show up anyway」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Apparently he turned in a completely blank sheet on the first day of exams」

name: Synn
message: 「She didn't even come in today, so...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Things didn't go so well with her...」
I want Azel to have a sparkling school life too, though...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, hey, I'm sure it'll work out! We still have plenty of time!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, you're right!」
A heavy atmosphere.
No, no! I can't just keep moping around--I need to cheer Nanaka up for once!
When it comes to topics that make Nanaka happy, there's really only...

name: Synn
message: 「By the way」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「You really like sweets, don't you, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why are you bringing that up now? Of course I love them.」
If I keep pressing forward like this, we should get right back to our usual childhood-friend banter!

name: Synn
message: 「Is that why you joined the Sweets Club?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um... well, that's...」

name: Synn
message: 「They're not around anymore, but you saw what the upperclassmen were doing and decided to join, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Was... that how it went?」

name: Synn
message: 「It wasn't?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wonder how it was...?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're a great cook, aren't you, Nanaka? I figure you also had the option of joining a cooking club or something along those lines.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um, well, that's... I guess I probably didn't want to bring the family business into school with me, maybe.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, I don't think I had any other motive besides just liking sweets.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, yeah...」

name: Synn
message: 「Say, didn't the upperclassmen ever make sweets themselves?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't remember... Even if someone did feed it to me, it probably wasn't all that delicious」

name: Synn
message: 「You have a refined palate, Nanaka. Your standards are just really strict」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I can't imagine you don't have the talent for making sweets, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's the same as how critics and authors are two different things」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though the soba you make for us is so delicious」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because soba and sweets are completely different」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I know so!」

name: Synn
message: 「What about making soba out of Mont Blanc! Or the other way around, making Mont Blanc out of soba!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They only look similar in shape, they're totally different」

name: Nanaka
message: 「First of all, doing something like that is disrespectful to both of them」

name: Synn
message: 「If I had to force a name for it, Soba Blanc?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's really pushing it」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah~~. Scratch that last part」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, if you're the one making them, Nanaka, I'm sure your sweets would be delicious」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Things won't go that smoothly... probably」
